name: ClickSyncr for Moosend – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Moosend – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator connects Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, and Forminator to Moosend. Each configured form sends its submissions to the Moosend list you choose, with no code required.

“Moosend” is a trademark of its respective owner. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Moosend.

External services

Optional signal sharing sends software versions, aggregate configuration and delivery counts, and random installation/device identifiers to Signls only after an administrator enables it in this plugin’s signal-sharing settings. It excludes contact/submission values and credentials. You can turn sharing off at any time. See external services and privacy details.

This plugin connects to Moosend. When you connect, refresh or open a configured form’s settings, it authenticates with your API key and requests the available lists, fields and account settings. A configured form submission sends the email address and the fields you map to your selected destination. A test submission sends the test address and configured fields. Subscription and consent settings determine whether a submission is sent.

Terms of service | Privacy policy

Privacy

ClickSyncr does not set tracking cookies or send visitor IP addresses to a geolocation service. If you map context fields, the mapped page URL, IP address, browser information or submission time is sent to Moosend. Optional sender context adds the page, form, time and browser to the site owner’s notification email. API credentials, form settings and sync counters are stored in your WordPress database. Administrators can enable a local diagnostic log with redacted personal data. ClickSyncr does not receive your form submissions.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “ClickSyncr for Moosend – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator”.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Edit a form in any supported builder and open its ClickSyncr for Moosend – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable & Forminator settings.
  4. Paste your Moosend API key, choose a list, and map your fields (email is required). Save.
